# Upstream patch queue

Every change to a vendored file sits inside `// ANTICHAT-PATCH: UP-### <why>` … `// ANTICHAT-PATCH-END` and has a row here (upstream.md §1 rule 2, §3.4). `tools/ci/patch-lint.py` checks both directions. File paths are relative to `Packages/OsaurusCore/` of `Vendor/osaurus@2922745/`. Kinds: `access`, `rebrand`, `strip`, `hook`, `behaviour`, `build`, `test`.
